profile.reasoning: Daniel Nakamura is a first-time founder in his early 30s, building 'Zenith,' a platform connecting certified mindfulness and meditation teachers with individuals seeking personalized guidance. He previously spent 8 years in high-pressure finance, experiencing burnout firsthand which sparked his passion for preventative mental wellness. He's *very* metrics-driven despite the 'soft' nature of the wellness space, constantly tracking user engagement and teacher retention. He's recently secured seed funding and is focused on scaling the platform and building brand awareness. He's a bit of a perfectionist and can be overly analytical, sometimes getting bogged down in details. He's looking for strategic advisors with experience in scaling marketplaces and individuals who can offer introductions to potential corporate wellness partners. He's based in Los Angeles and prioritizes efficient communication.
profile.positioning: I'm the founder of Zenith, a curated marketplace connecting individuals with certified mindfulness and meditation teachers for personalized, one-on-one guidance. We’re addressing a critical gap in the wellness market: accessibility to qualified, vetted instructors and a personalized approach beyond generic apps. Zenith isn’t just about meditation; it’s about building a sustainable wellness practice integrated into daily life.  We’ve recently closed a $1.2M seed round and are focused on expanding our teacher network and driving user acquisition.  Early traction has been incredibly promising, with a 65% user retention rate after the first month and a Net Promoter Score of 72. We're building a platform that empowers both practitioners and individuals to thrive, fostering a community centered around genuine connection and mindful living.
